entry.description: One entry of a career, education, or certification list: a square logo tile on the left, and the Markdown inside on the right, usually a heading, a role line, bullets, and links. Consecutive entries are joined by a rail below each logo, so the list reads as a timeline.

attributes.name: logo
attributes.description: The organization's logo as a square image, as a path relative to the note. The tile's own background is part of the image. Decorative, because the heading beside it names the organization.

layer.description: One layer of a skills stack, such as Process or Store: its name on the left and the cv_skill lines inside it as a wrapping row of tools.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The layer's name, shown as its heading.

skill.description: One tool in a layer, with a dot for how deep it went: used at work, built a project with it, or studied. With used, the tool opens on tap to show where it was used.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: work, project, or studied. Anything else counts as studied.

attributes.name: used
attributes.description: Where the tool was used, such as "KDM Force, Aqueduct". Left out, the tool does not open.

legend.description: What each dot means: used at work, built a project with it, or studied.
